title: GOAL: Adaptive Parallelism S1 — scheduling telemetry, deterministic interference, execution waves, critical-path priority, graph-aware interference and stale-work detection (brief priorities 0-4)
spec: Program brief: .orchestrator/adaptive-parallelism-program.md (user text 2026-09-21). This goal implements priorities 0 to 4 of the brief behind a [scheduler] config table whose default mode is shadow: the daemon keeps its first-come dispatch while logging what the wave scheduler would have done, so the next goal can compare shadow against baseline before flipping mode = active. Priorities 5 to 14 are later goals, each gated on the telemetry this goal produces. Base: main at the goal branch cut. Invariants (brief, Hard safety invariants): dependencies, scopes, tests-green, mandatory and security reviews, executor and account limits, merge lock, serial goal-branch integration and human approval for main are never bypassed; every adaptive feature has a deterministic fallback, an observable decision reason, telemetry, safe configuration, tests and a revert path.
acceptance: scorecard --parallelism reports per-goal concurrency, queue wait, execution, review, merge wait, dependency wait, wall clock, critical path, merge conflicts, rebase failures, stale-work events and dispatch-skip reasons; baseline save/compare carry the block
orchestrator/interference.py classifies any two tasks as none/soft/hard with reasons from scope, dependencies and (when fresh) the graphify graph, deterministic and covered by tests

daemon dispatch in [scheduler].mode = shadow logs the wave it would pick (interference-compatible set, critical-path order) without changing dispatch; mode = active dispatches the wave; mode = off disables both; every skipped ready task has a recorded reason
stale-work detection records when a task's base moved across its surface before review and, when [scheduler].stale_rebase is on, rebases before opening reviews, never discarding work

external .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh green on the goal branch head; retrospective in decisions.md records latency, cost, first-pass and contention effects (or that the after side awaits live evidence)
